requiredFields.surface: overview | a | b | film | transcript | archive | metadata | distribution
requiredFields.claimType: external-fact | implementation-fact | synthesis | inference | synthetic | aspiration
requiredFields.sourceUrl: Stable public URL or lawful public surrogate
requiredFields.sourceLocator: Page, section, table, figure, paragraph, or timestamp
requiredFields.supportReasoning: Why the evidence supports the precise wording
requiredFields.limitations: Scope, population, jurisdiction, freshness, and uncertainty

failClosedRules: A repository path or working interface certifies implementation only, never an external factual proposition.
A named source without a stable locator cannot receive a certify disposition.
Inference, synthesis, synthetic scenarios, and aspirations must be visually distinguished from facts.
Archive, overview, A, B, film, transcript, metadata, and distribution copy must agree before promotion.
Every material external factual claim requires successful second review.
buildGate: Public status updated only after every material claim passes
